items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: Kid Thomas, he went through the whole Arben book... Can you imagine Arben being like, wah! I didn't know he would do the Arben method.

ctx.x: Well, we're talking about chords now.

Yeah, well, I'll just finish it up briefly on chords. These are just, it kind of starts at the beginning. These are the basic things you have before you start thinking about style or anything else. And it would be wonderful for all the musicians to have a complete training in classical music. Real, complete, legitimate training. All the New Orleans, contrary to popular belief, did. From the TOs, and of course this is all rehash of old stuff. But from all the men that you've interviewed and from the guys that I've…
Do you think that it would help if every guy took piano in the back?
